findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess calls in wheel package
 * @description Finding subprocess calls that could be vulnerable to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-calls
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "popen2", "popen3", "popen4"]).getACall()
select call, "Subprocess call that could be vulnerable to command injection if arguments are not properly sanitized."
findings.hypothesis: Command injection via subprocess calls with untrusted input

message.text: Subprocess call that could be vulnerable to command injection if arguments are not properly sanitized.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Detailed subprocess call analysis
 * @description Get detailed information about subprocess calls
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-details
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::ExprNode arg
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "Popen"]).getACall() and
  arg = call.getArg(0)
select call, "Subprocess call with first argument: " + arg.asExpr().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Check what arguments are passed to subprocess calls to assess command injection risk
